B passes all gates and has a far more complete, systematic brand guide (usage rules, tokens, motion, a11y), while A fails contrast, min text size and reduced-motion. Note the supplied screenshots were of an unrelated page for both, so this verdict rests on source and audit reports.

B is the more distinctive and memorable design, but it fails the contrast gate with real small-text failures and has clipped and tiny text, so it caps at 50. A passes every gate with a consistent, polished system and a working contact form, so I would ship A and fix B's contrast and clipping if the bolder direction is wanted.
